## What changed

Describe the feature or document change and its rubric requirement.

## Verification

Describe checks actually performed. For document-only work, state that no application tests were run. For implementation work, include Maven test results and the relevant manual GUI check.

## Remaining work

List incomplete items honestly. Do not mark instructor approval, live API connectivity or individual contributions complete without evidence.

## Contributors

List the actual contributors and their work. Each member must commit under their own identity.

Course checkpoint submission PRs must remain open for instructor grading; do not merge them yourselves.
